name: Build a Persian service-business homepage with one primary action
query: برای یک شرکت طراحی سایت، صفحه‌ی اول وردپرس فارسی بساز. قالب بلوکی است. می‌خواهم حرفه‌ای و خلاقانه باشد.
expected_behavior: Step 1: Do not start laying out; answer the five questions in SKILL.md §0, including a single primary action
Step 2: Pick the service-business skeleton from references/section-patterns.md and cap sections at 8
Step 3: Write real Persian copy — hero headline under 9 words, specific CTA verbs, no «خوش آمدید»
Step 4: Design the 360 px layout first, with RTL reading order and logical CSS properties
Step 5: Apply the Persian type scale: body 17px+, line-height 1.8-2.0, zero letter-spacing
Step 6: Build templates/front-page.html plus patterns, following wp-patterns markup rules
Step 7: Configure any Query Loop with inherit:false and a query-no-results empty state
Step 8: Refuse to invent testimonials, client logos, or statistics; mark placeholders explicitly
Step 9: Run scripts/homepage_check.mjs and walk references/homepage-checklist.md
success_criteria: Exactly one h1, sensible heading order, no level jumps
One visually dominant primary CTA; secondary actions are demoted
Hero headline is under 9 words and contains a concrete noun and verb
No banned homepage phrase from references/persian-copywriting.md §8 appears
Body font size is 17px or more and line-height is 1.8-2.0 in theme.json
No letter-spacing is applied to Persian text
No inline <style> tags; colours and spacing come from theme.json presets
Every Query Loop sets inherit:false and includes query-no-results
No fabricated testimonials, logos, or numbers; placeholders are labelled
No horizontal scroll at 360 px and all strings are escaped and translatable
